WEEKDAY READERS ROTA 23rd Nov Peggy 30th Nov Gearoid 7th Dec Sr. Mary 14th Dec Frances MASS OF REMEMBRANCE Our annual Mass of Remembrance for all who died in St. Senan’s Parish this year will take place on Friday 27th Nov 7.30pm in St. Senan’s Church Kilrush. EUCHARISTIC MINISTERS DAILY ROTA Nov 23rd Ann Vaughan Nov 30th Maisie Flynn, Roisin Horgan KILRUSH GRAVEYARD COMMITTEE Thank you for the recent church gate collection pro ceeds of €4,315 to date. The voluntary committee will host an open meeting in late November to address falling revenue receipts, explo re alternative funding streams and invite representatives from all are as of the parish to serve on the voluntary committee. Your attendance would appreciated. REMEMBRANCE TREE CARDS Are now available at the Parish Office. €5 each. Ceremony takes place on Wed 2nd Dec 7pm in St. Senan’s Church. All proceeds this year go to Temple Street children’s hospital & A. & multi disability classes in St. Senan’s Primary School. CHRISTMAS PARTY Seniors Christmas Party for Kilrush parishioners returns this year on Sunday December 6th. Dinner at 1pm followed by music & dancing until 4pm . Please call to the parish office in the community centre to register your name and pay the €10 contribution . Looking forward to welcoming everyone on the day. PARISH CHRISTMAS MASS CARDS are now available from the Parish Office and Parish Shop. Each card costs €4 or three cards f or €10. All proceeds this year will go towards supporting a mission in India, where physically challenged children are lovingly cared for. Your generosity and support are greatly appreciated. May God Bless You. 50/50 DRAW Congratulations to Catherine Miniter who won €194 in last weeks draw. Next draw is Saturday 28th November after the 6.30pm mass. FIRST COMMUNION CALLS Fr. Ignatius will visit the sick and housebound in the coming week. RECENTLY BAPTISED We welcome into the Christian Community Henry Michael Newstrom ROSARY AT THE GROTTO There will be Rosary at the Grotto in Kilrush every Sunday evening throughout the year at 7pm. Everyone is welcome to join in. A O OF ADVENT This Sunday is known as “Christ the King” it is the last Sunday of the Church Liturgical Year. Next Sunday 29th November will be the first Sunday of Advent, when we begin the churches Liturgical New Year. Next week we begin our preparation for the birth of Jesus. Father all-powerful, God of love, you have raised our Lord Jesus Christ from death to life, resplendent in glory as King of creation. Open our hearts, free all the world to rejoice in his peace, to glory in his justice, to live his love. Bring all together in Jesus Christ your Son, whose k ingdom is with you and the Holy Spirit, One God, for ever and ever. Amen Kilrush
